Reason: The action of scrolling down in a static archived document (likely a PDF or scanned image from 1959) is unlikely to yield new data or interact with the content to extract specific lists of standards. WebSurfer tools typically cannot "read" the text within a document just by scrolling; it requires a specific extraction tool (like OCR or a document reader) or a search query to find the specific sections (e.g., "dried and dehydrated section"). Continuing to scroll without an extraction mechanism is inefficient and will not progress the goal of identifying the specific items to compare against 2023 standards. The agent should instead attempt to extract the text or search for specific terms within the document.
